sentences.en: The summit talks are to be broadcast simultaneously throughout the world.
sentences.zh: 峰会会谈将被同时向全世界直播。

sentences.en: The city is simultaneously killing me and reviving me.
sentences.zh: 这座城市既让我感到窒息又使我重获新生（意思是指这座城对我而言既是毁灭又是重生）。

sentences.en: Preparations for the new project are under way in both companies simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 两家公司正在同步进行新项目的准备工作。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：simult（相类似）+aneous（有…特征的）+ly（…地）→（时间）相同地→同时发生地
